Metadata.description: Backend Developer training materials, plus AWS SAA-C03 review and practice exams.

welcome.heading: Welcome
welcome.intro: Welcome to the Backend Developer training program.
items: Master the fundamentals of web programming
Understand how real-world backend systems are built
Implement APIs and handle business logic in a project on your own

goals.heading: Goals after the training
goals.listIntro: Once you finish, you will be able to:
items: Understand and use PHP to handle backend logic
Know the fundamentals of HTML / CSS / JavaScript
Read and work with a real-world codebase

aws.description: Keywords, common traps and numbers to memorize, compiled from 6 Solutions Architect – Associate practice exams.

exams.title: AWS SAA-C03 Practice Exams
exams.description: 65-question exams like the real test: Practice mode with instant explanations, timed Exam mode, per-domain scoring and answer review.
